title: A Survey of Useful LLM Evaluation
measurement_description: The paper, citing Li et al. (2023b), identifies the manifestation of religious biases as a major challenge for LLMs, especially in the financial domain. It also indirectly touches on ethical decision-making and human values, which may involve religious perspectives.
findings: The paper, citing Li et al. (2023b), highlighted that the manifestation of religious biases is a major challenge for LLMs in financial applications. It also notes that LLMs generally align with common sense in straightforward ethical situations but show uncertainty in ambiguous contexts, which could implicitly include religiously-tinged dilemmas. Duan et al. (2024) found many models misaligned with intrinsic values when exploring ethical values using Moral Foundation Theory.
